student_learning_goal: I can use likelihood words to make a prediction.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use likelihood words to make a prediction.
header.character_watermark: Maybe Mae the Cat in the top-right with a question-mark hat and a clipboard. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Predict 4 coin/dice outcomes using a likelihood word.
parts.visual_layout: Four prediction prompts with coin and dice icons and a blank line for the likelihood word.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 prediction layout for likelihood worksheet, B&W line art. 4 boxes: '10 coin flips, get 5 heads', '10 dice rolls, get a 6', 'flip 1 coin and get tails', 'roll 1 die and get a 7'. Each box has a blank line for the likelihood word.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P1_COINDICE at Part 1: keywords name the coin and dice prediction prompts.

parts.answer_key: 5 heads=equally likely, 6 on dice=unlikely, tails=equally likely, 7 on die=impossible.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 weather/school scenarios, write a prediction word AND a decision.
parts.visual_layout: Four scenario boxes with two response lines each: prediction word and decision.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 prediction-and-decision layout for likelihood worksheet, B&W line art. 4 scenario boxes: 'Snow tomorrow', 'Math test Friday', 'Treat at lunch', 'Sun rises'. Each box has 2 response lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_DECIDE at Part 2: keywords name the prediction-decision linkage.

parts.answer_key: Sample: snow likely → wear boots; test certain → study tonight; treat unlikely → don't expect; sun rises certain → no decision needed.

parts.student_instructions: ONE of your predictions changes. New info: 'It just snowed!' Revise.
parts.visual_layout: Sentence frame with a revision box for the updated likelihood word and a short explanation line.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 revision layout for likelihood worksheet. Sentence frame: 'I first predicted ___. New info: ___. I revise to ___.' Below: 3 lines for student.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P3_REVISE at Part 3: keywords name the revise-with-new-info task.

parts.answer_key: Sample: predicted unlikely snow; new info snowed; revise to certain.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, predict 2 more events from your day.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Formative — check word use and decision linkage.
